allocation.seed_storage: Outside the public repository and outside every subject context; reveal only after the experiment is frozen or for an authorized coordinator launch.

analysis_plan.context_relation: Report correctness by initial and final model-visible byte fraction; provider-recorded input tokens are secondary and must not replace byte provenance.
analysis_plan.intervals: Two-sided 95% Wilson intervals for per-arm correctness and task-stratified bootstrap intervals for paired treatment-minus-control differences, with the bootstrap seed published in the result record.
analysis_plan.missing_data: No imputation. A missing or invalid subject halts the experiment and remains visibly classified; it cannot be silently discarded or replaced.
analysis_plan.primary_estimand: Correctness pass rate for each arm and the paired correctness difference between each treatment and raw-control across task-by-repetition blocks.
analysis_plan.primary_tests: Three two-sided exact McNemar comparisons against raw-control with Holm family-wise correction at alpha 0.05.
analysis_plan.sample_size_limit: Sixty subjects per arm is a bounded first experiment, not a universal safety proof; at a 50 percent rate its unstratified 95 percent interval remains approximately plus or minus 12.5 percentage points.

claim_limits: Preregistration and provider-free adapter tests are not EXP-001 model results.
The public model identifier does not prove immutable underlying weights because no distinct dated snapshot was listed.
The encrypted mapping protects subject blinding only while the coordinator seed remains outside subject context.
The bounded Python-only corpus cannot establish a general context-safety frontier.
No token, cost, latency, correctness, or causal benefit is measured before authorized subject runs.

launch_authorization_contract.batch_policy: Four label-specific one-run authorization artifacts and a provider-free coordinator preflight must exist before the first subject in a balanced block launches; completing preregistration does not authorize 240 provider calls.
launch_authorization_contract.catalogue_preflight: Before every provider run, verify that gpt-5.6-sol remains the documented exact public identifier and that no dated snapshot or incompatible parameter change requires an amendment.
launch_authorization_contract.provider_credential: OPENAI_API_KEY is injected only at process launch and is never written to results or exposed to subject tools.
launch_authorization_contract.required_external_artifact: A non-repository authorization JSON bound to this preregistration identity and one opaque subject label, permitting exactly one provider run and accepting at least the USD 6.30 conservative maximum_spend_usd.

repetition_and_stopping.completion_rule: Complete only after all 60 balanced task-by-repetition blocks contain one valid fresh subject in each arm and every result has the same deterministic correctness gate.
immediate_stop_conditions: subject receives evaluator-only material, an arm identity, allocation seed, or sealed mapping
subject adapter, model echo, configuration identity, environment identity, or frozen artifact differs
provider or transport failure, incomplete response, automatic retry, fallback, or session resume
missing provider usage, tool event, final artifact, oracle result, or classification telemetry
authorization or monetary ceiling cannot be proven before a provider request
an interrupted or partially completed block
repetition_and_stopping.replacement_rule: No automatic replacement. Any immediate-stop condition halts the experiment; resumption or replacement requires a versioned preregistration amendment before another provider request.
